Cristiano Ronaldo Nears 1,000 Career Goals After Al-Nassr Hat-Trick

01 Nov 2026, 10:48 PM IST · GlobeWire Daily Sports Desk · Source: www.bbc.co.uk

A Milestone performance

Cristiano Ronaldo has reached 985 career goals following a standout performance for Al-Nassr in their 5-3 victory over Al-Kholood in the Saudi Pro League. The 41-year-old forward secured a hat-trick within a 15-minute window during the second half, marking the 67th hat-trick of his professional career.

Match context

  • Scoreline: Al-Nassr defeated Al-Kholood 5-3.
  • Scoring contributors: Angelo Gabriel and Sadio Mane also found the net for Al-Nassr.
  • Playmaking: Reports indicate teammate Joao Felix provided four assists during the match, two of which directly set up Ronaldo’s goals.

Career progression and context

Ronaldo continues to move toward the 1,000-goal mark, a milestone that remains a focal point of his late-career narrative. According to available statistics, the breakdown of his 67 hat-tricks is as follows:

  • Real Madrid: 44
  • Portugal: 10
  • Al-Nassr: 7
  • Manchester United: 3
  • Juventus: 3

League standing

Al-Nassr currently holds second place in the Saudi Pro League. While they trail league leaders Al-Qadsiah, the club maintains a game in hand. Ronaldo, who has secured league titles in England, Spain, Italy, and Saudi Arabia, is currently in the latter portion of his contract with Al-Nassr. He has previously indicated in media statements that his playing career may be nearing its conclusion.
